campuses.title: Campus life
campuses.text:
Living on Campus
      
          APU’s campus is well-situated in a high-technology park environment, and is equipped to enable every student to get the most out of your study experience at APU.

paragraphs: Asia Pacific University of Technology and Innovation (APU) is a private university in Bukit Jalil, Kuala Lumpur, established in 1993 as the Asia Pacific Institute of Information Technology (APIIT) in response to Malaysia's IT-professional shortage. APU evolved through university college status (UCTI, 2004) into a fully fledged university and now operates from an 11.7-acre urban campus inside Technology Park Malaysia, less than 16 km from the iconic Petronas Twin Towers.

APU is ranked in the Top 2% globally in the QS World University Rankings 2026 (=597) and in the Top 150 in Asia (=147). It is the first and only Malaysian university to achieve QAA UK Accreditation, and the Ministry of Higher Education tracer study reports 100% graduate employability.

Programmes are heavily focused on technology — Computer Science, Cyber Security, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, Computer Games Development, Engineering, FinTech, plus strong Business, Accounting, Actuarial, Design and Psychology schools. Specialist labs include Cyber Security, AI, IoT, Games and FinTech.

APU is ranked #16 globally for international student diversity — students from 130+ nationalities study on the Kuala Lumpur campus. APU enjoys long-standing twinning partnerships with Staffordshire University (UK) and De Montfort University (UK) for dual-award programmes.
paragraphsRu: Asia Pacific University of Technology and Innovation (APU) — частный университет в Bukit Jalil, Куала-Лумпур. Основан в 1993 как Asia Pacific Institute of Information Technology (APIIT) для решения дефицита IT-специалистов в Малайзии. В 2004 году получил статус university college (UCTI), позже — полноценный университет. Кампус площадью 11.7 акров расположен в Technology Park Malaysia, в 16 км от Petronas Twin Towers.

APU входит в Top 2% мира по QS World University Rankings 2026 (=597) и Top 150 Азии (=147). Первый и единственный малазийский университет с аккредитацией QAA UK. Tracer study Министерства высшего образования показывает 100% трудоустройство выпускников.

Программы сфокусированы на технологиях — Computer Science, Cyber Security, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, Computer Games Development, Engineering, FinTech, а также сильные направления Business, Accounting, Actuarial, Design и Psychology. Специализированные лаборатории — Cyber Security, AI, IoT, Games и FinTech.

APU занимает #16 в мире по международному разнообразию — студенты из 130+ стран. Долгосрочные twinning-партнёрства со Staffordshire University (UK) и De Montfort University (UK) для dual-award программ.
